backend/main.mo: Motoko actor implementing the backend for QuickRepair, including user registration/profile management, feedback submission/deletion, and rating storage, all protected by role-based access control.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting the IP-based location detection feature implemented in BookingFormSection.tsx, useIpLocation.ts, and BookingPage.tsx, with high confidence and linked to test REQ-8.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: A JSON-formatted text file containing short summaries of each frontend source file, describing their purpose, styling, and key functionality changes.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS entry file defining CSS custom properties (OKLCH color tokens) for light and dark themes, including sidebar, chart, and UI component color variables.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with SEO meta tags, Open Graph/Twitter Card tags, Google site verification, structured data (LocalBusiness schema), and preconnect hints for ICP and identity services.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React app component that handles client-side routing via pathname matching, lazy-loads below-fold sections, and renders pages including Home, Admin, Booking, BookingHistory, MechanicRegistration, and Terms.
frontend/src/components/AboutSection.tsx: Renders the 'About Us' section with a two-column layout featuring descriptive text about QuickRepair and four highlight cards (response time, verified professionals, transparent pricing, local coverage) with fade-in animation.
frontend/src/components/AdminPage.tsx: Password-protected admin dashboard that allows managing users, feedback, services (CRUD), and mechanic registrations using React Query hooks, with session persistence via localStorage.
frontend/src/components/BookingFormSecti: Booking form section that requires Internet Identity authentication, auto-fills address from IP geolocation, submits via FormSubmit fetch, and shows a success overlay with sound on completion.
frontend/src/components/BookingSuccessOv: Full-screen portal overlay displaying an animated SVG checkmark circle and 'Booking Confirmed' message that auto-dismisses after 2.8 seconds or on user tap.
frontend/src/components/ContactSection.t: Displays contact information (phone, email, working hours) and a list of service areas in a two-column card layout with fade-in animation.
frontend/src/components/FAQSection.tsx: Accordion-style FAQ section with 11 questions covering response time, pricing, service areas, and policies, using local state to track the open item and a fade-in hook.
Renders a feedback/reviews section with sample and live reviews fetched via React Query hooks, displaying star ratings and allowing authenticated users to submit new feedback.
frontend/src/components/FloatingCallButt: A fixed floating button that links to a phone number (tel:) with a gradient style and 'Call Now' label.
frontend/src/components/FloatingWhatsApp: A fixed floating WhatsApp button with a pulse animation that opens a pre-filled WhatsApp chat link.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Site footer with logo, smooth-scroll nav links, a booking button, copyright notice, and a caffeine.ai attribution link.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Fixed top navigation header with scroll-aware styling, Internet Identity login/logout, user profile dropdown, and a mobile navigation drawer.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Full-screen hero section with animated fade-in content, a background image with overlay, tagline, and CTA buttons for booking and services.
frontend/src/components/HowItWorksSectio: Three-step process section (Book, Arrive, Solved) with icons, connector lines, and fade-in animation explaining the service workflow.
frontend/src/components/NavigationDrawer: A mobile slide-in navigation drawer component that highlights the active section via scroll spy and conditionally shows Booking History for authenticated users.
frontend/src/components/Overlay.tsx: A simple full-screen semi-transparent overlay component used to dim the background when the navigation drawer is open on mobile.
frontend/src/components/ProfileModal.tsx: A modal form for collecting and submitting a user's name, phone number, and service area to complete their profile via the registerUser mutation.
frontend/src/components/ServiceCard.tsx: A card component that displays a single service with its icon, description, starting price, and a 'Book Online' button that navigates to the booking page.
A section component that fetches and displays service cards from the backend, falling back to hardcoded services if none are returned, with a loading spinner during fetch.
frontend/src/components/TrustStatsBar.ts: A horizontal stats bar component that displays three trust indicators (happy customers, response time, star rating) with fade-in animation on scroll.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using React Query, invalidating dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useFadeIn.ts: A hook that uses IntersectionObserver to set a visibility flag when the referenced element scrolls into view, enabling CSS fade-in animations.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an InternetIdentityProvider and useInternetIdentity hook for managing ICP Internet Identity authentication state, including login, logout, and identity persistence via AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useIpLocation.ts: Custom React hook that fetches the user's location (city, region, country, lat/lon) from ipapi.co and returns status, a status message, and the location data.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Centralizes all React Query hooks for the app, including feedback CRUD, user profile management, admin checks, bookings, and mechanic registration, each wired to the ICP actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useScrollSpy.ts: Custom React hook that tracks which section ID is currently in view based on scroll position, returning the active section ID.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet importing Google Fonts and Tailwind, defining CSS custom properties for the dark theme, and declaring animations for fade-ins, service card hovers, and a GPay-style booking success overlay.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrapping the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/BookingHistoryPage.ts: Page that displays a logged-in user's past bookings sorted newest-first, showing service ID, address, phone, date, and time for each booking card.
frontend/src/pages/BookingPage.tsx: Booking form page that auto-fills the address from IP geolocation, submits via FormSubmit, and shows a GPay-style success overlay with a sound effect on completion.
frontend/src/pages/MechanicRegistrationP: Mechanic registration form page with client-side validation that submits applicant details via a mutation hook and displays a GPay-style success overlay on success.
frontend/src/pages/TermsPage.tsx: Renders the QuickRepair Terms and Policies page with sections covering response time, service guarantee, pricing, service area, and customer feedback. Uses a dark-themed layout with a sticky header and card-based policy sections.
frontend/src/utils/playSuccessSound.ts: Provides a utility function that plays a Google Pay-style ascending C-E-G major chord arpeggio using the Web Audio API. Silently fails if the API is unavailable.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module for extracting, persisting, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage fallback support. Includes helpers to store/retrieve/clear session parameters and remove sensitive params from the URL bar.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom fonts, brand colors, surface palette, box shadows, border radii, and keyframe animations for the QuickRepair frontend. Includes plugins for typography, container queries, and animate.
project_state.json: Tracks the current state of the QuickRepair project at version 7, summarizing completed SEO keyword work and the in-progress IP-based location detection feature for the contact form. Lists existing features by ID with associated requirement references.
